Day twenty-eight. The Jarl comes to your hut... alone, in the middle of the night.
He knew Hakon set the fire... from the very first night.
He was my only son. So I sent my brother to the forest instead. I have carried it... for ten years.
He looks a hundred years old.
In two nights, you will lose the vote. I cannot save you. I could not even save my brother.
